title: Schlag gegen mutmaßliche kriminelle Vereinigung – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse und Haftbefehle vollstreckt sowie Vermögenswerte in Millionenhöhe gesichert

extraction.summaryEn: Police and prosecutors executed four arrest warrants and searches at 16 properties in Berlin and Brandenburg against a suspected criminal group accused of money laundering. Around 2 million euros in bank funds were frozen, along with cash, gold, a diamond, luxury watches and a Lamborghini.
